title: Beyond Second-Order Information: Paid Logistic Regression with Noisy Features
abstract: arXiv:2610.12919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider online binary prediction with paid stochastic features, where the learner can spend resources to obtain better observations of the underlying features. This setting is motivated by applications such as medical testing, where additional cost can provide more precise measurements of patient's features for predicting a binary outcome. At each round, a latent feature is drawn i.i.d., the response is generated through a logistic model, and the learner chooses how much to pay before observing a noisy version of the feature. The goal of learner is to jointly control prediction loss and acquisition cost. In contrast to the former result on the online linear regression with paid features, covariance information alone is no longer sufficient: two noise distributions with the same covariance may induce different optimal logistic losses, and lower variance can even lead to higher loss. translated_title: 超越二阶信息：带噪声特征的付费逻辑回归
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有付费随机特征的在线二分类预测问题，其中学习者可以花费资源来获得对潜在特征的更好观测。这一设定受医学检测等应用的启发：额外花费可以提供对患者特征更精确的测量，从而更好地预测二元结果。在每一轮中，一个潜在特征被独立同分布地抽取，响应通过逻辑（logistic）模型生成，学习者在观测到带噪声的特征版本之前选择支付多少费用。学习者的目标是对预测损失和特征获取成本进行联合控制。与以往关于带付费特征的在线线性回归的结果不同，仅有协方差信息已不再足够：两个具有相同协方差的噪声分布可能导致不同的最优逻辑损失，甚至更低的方差反而会带来更高的损失。在一种结构性排序下，更大的支付…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该文提出带付费噪声特征的在线逻辑回归问题，证明与付费线性回归不同，仅凭协方差这类二阶信息已不足以刻画最优损失——相同协方差的噪声分布可产生不同损失、更低方差甚至导致更高损失，因此需要超越二阶信息的新结构刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper studies online logistic regression with paid noisy features and shows that, unlike paid linear regression, second-order (covariance) information alone is insufficient—noise distributions with the same covariance can induce different optimal losses, and lower variance can even increase loss—necessitating structure beyond second-order information.
